newsitem.title: USA: Comcast unit sells $1.0 bln 144A snr notes.
newsitem.headline: Comcast unit sells $1.0 bln 144A snr notes.

text.p: The following debt issue from Comcast Cellular Holdings was priced in the 144A private placement market via Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette Securities Corp on Monday, according to market sources.
The deal was increased to $1.0 billion from an original size of $900 million, sources added.
Comcast Ceullar Holdings is a unit of Comcast Corp, a provider of telephone services.
TYPE SNR NOTES ISS PRICE 99.837 FIRST PAY DATE 11/1/1997
LAST MOODY'S B2 YIELD 9.525 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
